# Reset first
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 54, 'col': 15}])

    ('top-left', 50, 25),
    ('top-right', 50, 35),

    ('bottom-left', 60, 25),
    ('bottom-right', 60, 35),
]

for cell_name, row, col in gray_cells:

    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    green_count = 0
    gray_count = 0
    white_count = 0
    for node in nodes:
        boundary = node['boundary']
        if boundary:
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
            if 47 <= min_row <= 63 and 22 <= min_col <= 39:
                if node['color'] == 'N':
                    green_count += 1
                elif node['color'] == 'g':
                    gray_count += 1
                elif node['color'] == 'W':
                    white_count += 1
    
    print(f"After {cell_name}: Green={green_count}, Gray={gray_count}, White={white_count}, Level completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
